notes: Head correction on ἕνεκεν. Rules 71 and 95 settle an improper preposition's complex English frame on the frame's lexical noun, and rule 95 classifies this very lexeme as improper and heads its frame on the noun. Rule 78's holding is carried entirely by proper prepositions, so it is not precedent here. The unit's source and target tokens are unchanged; only target_head moves from t027 to t032.
